ImmutableLinkedList.ts asks only for ES2015 -- its generator, Iterable and Symbol.iterator go red at ES5 (TS2318/TS2304/TS2585) and are satisfied from ES2015 up; `??=` and the #private fields across these files are syntax, met by the ES2022 target, not by lib.
